tagline: Not everything needs to become a system. Small builds, finished the day they were started, and kept as sketches. A sketch is not a failed painting.
titleTail: built in an afternoon, kept as sketches
lede: Small builds that were finished the day they were started. They're listed as sketches so they stop reading as unfinished obligations, which is what happens to anything kept in a folder called “misc”.

features.d: two passes at atmosphere over mechanics. Neither became a game. Both were the point at the time.
an orbital toy, built well before the orbital mechanics got done properly in Cartograph. The interest preceded the rigour.
a route optimiser and a prompt engine. Both solved their afternoon and stopped.

cards.html: Four sketches outgrew the pile and got pages of their own: Watch Your Grass (now a full game), Synodic, Balloon and The Monstrosity.

closing: They are not unfinished. They are done.
